notes.title: Horizon Shift '81 is now availble on the Nintendo Switch
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Horizon Shift '81 is now available for purchase on the Nintendo Switch eShop!

[u]Here's the trailer: [/u]
https://youtu.be/Z_FAM8zk-u0


[u]And here's a little bit about the game[/u]

Horizon Shift '81 is an explosive wave based, single screen, retro shooter. 
Do what it takes to protect your horizon from the ever encroaching enemy attack! 
Jump, Shoot, Dash and Flip your way through over 36 intense stages. 
Horizon Shift '81 is the sequel to the TIGA award nominated shooter, Horizon Shift.

There's more info on my [url=www.flumpstudios.co.uk]website [/url]

Thanks guys :)

notes.title: Horizon Shift '81 is only 4 days away!
notes.notes:
The sequel to the 2015 TIGA award nominatied shooter, Horizon Shift launches on the 20th of December on the Nintendo Switch!

Horizon Shift ’81 is my love letter to all my favourite 80’s arcade games. A mishmash or remix of all the games I was obsessed with as a kid – Galaga, Asteroid, Tempest, Defender Missile Command to name a few. My goal was always to reproduce the excitement I remember feeling, playing those games in my local fish and chip shop, or on the rare occasions I was able to visit an actual Arcade.

Here's the offical trailer if you missed it
https://youtu.be/DaKhkTYu5UM


For more details check out the  Flump Studios website here http://www.flumpstudios.co.uk/

notes.title: Atari 2600 version of Horizon Shift!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

After finishing work on Horizon Shift '81, the only logical next step was to work on an Atari 2600 version of Horizon Shift :)

Here's a little bit of footage.

https://youtu.be/2WjgdyP-xWM

The ROM will be made available with the release of Horizon Shfit '81 on the Nintendo Switch. 

I'm also looking at doing a limited run of Physical copies, but not 100% sure that's feasible yet.

notes.title: New controller option added
notes.notes:
Latest update includes the new Type D controller option.

Type D allows the player to toggle the ships direction with the triggers or shoulder buttons, whilst using the face buttons for the remaining gameplay.

Big thanks to ThreeSon for the suggestion, I think it works really well :)

notes.notes:

2.The steam overlay is working again.

notes.title: Major update (NW.exe fix and loading time massivly reduced)
notes.notes:
OK, biggest update so far. 3 huge fixes.

1. Fixed the nw.exe error (as far as I can tell)
2. Reduced RAM usage by a lot
3. Reduced intial load tim by 99%, most people shouldn't even get a loading bar now.

Let me know if you have any problems, thanks so much for your ongoing support.

notes.title: Horizon Shift Closed Beta!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone out there in steam land!!!

We're running a closed beta for our new game Horizon Shift.
The game is out on the 29th of May and we want everything to be just right.
We didn't think early access was a good idea so we've gone with a closed beta instead.

If you'd like to participate please sign up here:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1cD3drKIl1aE4B_e9FzhY8tkUMj3_eu17NlIn6nIJHQA/viewform?c=0&w=1

We'll try and get as many codes out as possible but we are limited.

Thanks guys!
